breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both Dirichlet (u=0) and periodic. The ground truth removed the incorrect periodic condition. The generated specification correctly identified this conflict and only included the Dirichlet boundary condition, stating 'with Dirichlet boundary conditions u = 0 on all four edges', thus resolving the inconsistency.
